text:
sanjay: Quick async — ACMECorp private rollout tomorrow. Are we green on the airgap artifact signing and egress IPs?

tara: Not fully green. ACME's infra team flagged missing GPG key for the offline registry. They need the public key and instructions for import. cc @maria for the signing bits.

maria: I can export the key this afternoon. will post the short import steps. blocker: does the airgap image tar include /opt/redwood/config? we had one customer fail because config replaced during import.

owen: Confirmed: tar includes config. we should provide `--skip-config` script for them. small script I can paste.

owen: ```
# suggested import snippet
mkdir -p /var/lib/redwood/import
tar xzf redwood-airgap-v1.tgz -C /var/lib/redwood/import
# if you want to keep existing config
./tools/import.sh --skip-config
```

netops-lead: Egress IPs: we reserved 3 static NATs for ACME: 34.81.12.45, 34.81.12.46, 34.81.12.47. Are those published to their firewall team?

cs-jake: I sent the IP list earlier but they replied asking for CIDR ranges instead of single IPs for their rule templates. netops — can you provide minimal CIDR for each?

netops-lead: Each is /32. I'll put together a one-line table for them. also, do we need to surface our proxy SNI for TLS egress? ACME runs strict SNI.

infra-bot: deploy-notify: staging-airgap-import job succeeded (job 5823) — image signed sha256:ab12...

maria: thanks infra-bot. I'll attach the `.asc` public key and the import steps in the handoff doc.

netops-lead: SNI to provide: `gateway.redwood-inference.net`. confirm with security if we need to regionalize.

tara: Ownership matrix for tomorrow: netops owns firewall comms, infra owns artifact signing + import script, eng-platform oncall is primary for cutover, cs handles customer runbook and acceptance sign-off. I can push this to the playbook.

sanjay: assign owners in comments so it's clear: @netops-lead owns IP/CIDR publication, @maria exports key and posts import steps, @owen finalizes `--skip-config` import helper, @infra-bot will post artifact sha and job link. cs-jake to confirm with ACME once docs are sent.

cs-jake: I'll confirm by 17:00 PT today and escalate if they need extra VPN creds.

maria: posted key and short steps: https://internal.redwood/handbook/acme/airgap-import (docs)

owen: pushed import helper gist: https://internal.redwood/gists/import-skip-config

netops-lead: published CIDR list to ACME ticket and added /32s + example rule snippets: ```allow out tcp 443 to 34.81.12.45/32```

tara: thank you. final preflight checklist (async): 1) key + steps posted — done; 2) CIDRs published — done; 3) artifact sha verified — infra-bot job success; 4) runbook owner ack — cs-jake pending. once cs-jake marks accepted, we go green.

cs-jake: ack, will update by 16:45 PT. if no issues, we start cutover window at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sanjay: perfect. if anyone hits a blocker, @here call the oncall. otherwise we close this thread after cs sign-off. thanks all!
